topic: how Amazon earns more from advertising than from its subscription services and its physical stores
storyAngle: Amazon looks like a store, but its ad business out-earns its subscriptions and its physical stores.
doNotClaim: These are 2024 net sales (revenue) figures from the 10-K, not profit; do not say anything about ad profit or margin.
Do not say Prime; the 10-K line is called subscription services.
Do not say ads are Amazon's biggest business; third-party seller services is larger.

facts.claim: Amazon 2024 net sales from ADVERTISING services (sponsored ads, display and video ads sold to sellers, vendors, publishers and others) were $56,214 million.
say: fifty six point two billion dollars

facts.claim: Amazon 2024 net sales from SUBSCRIPTION services were $44,374 million.
say: forty four point four billion dollars

facts.claim: Amazon 2024 net sales from PHYSICAL STORES were $21,215 million.
say: twenty one point two billion dollars

derived.claim: Advertising net sales were more than two and a half times physical-store net sales (56.2 / 21.2 = 2.65).
say: more than two and a half times
